claim_boundary: Model phase closeout only; no existing membrane, sustained electrode mechanism, complete module, commercial performance, or measured net system-energy saving is validated.
determinism_scope: Source and result ZIP payloads are deterministic for fixed inputs; the complete package is intentionally time-, host-, and test-run-specific.

package_execution.note: The commit/tag containing generated release artifacts is created after packaging and cannot be self-recorded; bind it in the annotated tag.

selection.selection_policy: exact union of report-manifest records, nested scientific-manifest records, and the explicit V10 profile/frozen-study allowlist
